image_description: A side-profile view of a reddish-brown horse (sorrel) standing in a sandy enclosure. The horse has a uniform chestnut coat, a lighter flaxen mane and tail, and appears to be of athletic build. The background includes a wooden fence and some distant structures.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated head with large expressive eyes and mobile ears.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is visible in profile, showing an elongated shape typical of equines. Ears are upright and distinct.
The neck shows a clear arch and muscular definition consistent with the taxonomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Athletic build with tall, lean proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horse exhibits a lean, athletic physique with well-defined withers.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Uniform brownish-orange to light chestnut coat coloration with no black points.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coat is uniformly reddish-brown/chestnut. There are no black markings on the legs, ears, or muzzle (no black points).

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Mane and tail same color as body or lighter (flaxen).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mane and tail are visibly lighter than the body coat, appearing flaxen/blonde, which matches the sorrel description.
The chest appears deep and the back line is strong and level.
The tail is long and the hair texture appears flowing and natural.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Long slender legs with single hoof per foot.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: All four legs are visible, appearing slender and proportional. Hooves are present and appear structurally correct (single hoof per foot).

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific breed/color variant classification (Sorrel vs. generic Horse) and rule out misclassification artifacts.
To verify the anatomical correctness of the limbs, spine, and head position, ensuring no extra limbs or structural melting.
To assess overall image quality, checking for subtle texture anomalies, noise, or AI-generation blurring often found in lower-resolution generations.
To ensure the boundary between the horse and the background is sharp and that there is no 'bleeding' or fusion of the subject into the environment.

focus_areas: Coat color uniformity and absence of black points
Edge sharpness between horse and background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'no black points' constraint. Sorrels must not have black legs/ears/muzzle. Verify if the lighter areas on the legs are just lighting/reflection or actual coat color. Check for any subtle warping in the leg joints which might indicate AI structural failure despite correct overall pose.
